hero.campaign-heroes.finneasVilmar.biogr: Though Finneas Vilmar's thirst for power makes him a virtually unstoppable Necromancer, the ability of political manipulation and battle tactics elude him. He has joined with Sandro so he can use his skills to move himself through the ranks.
hero.campaign-heroes.finneasVilmar.name: Finneas
hero.campaign-heroes.finneasVilmar.speci: Casts Animate Dead with effect increased by 3% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
hero.campaign-heroes.generalKendal.biogr: Following King Gryphonheart's murder, General Morgan Kendal temporarily assumed the throne until a new successor could be found. History shall remember him as the only ruler of Erathia who allowed the capital city of Steadwick to be captured.
hero.campaign-heroes.generalKendal.name: Gen. Kendal
hero.campaign-heroes.generalKendal.speci: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Estates skill.
hero.campaign-heroes.ordwald.biography: Ordwald was the most powerful Lord in Nighon. He was an old but powerful warlock, receiving his lands from his much greater father. He rejected the warriors art's and turned to magic. Most likely that would mean that his father was a powerful Dungeon Overlord of Nighon. He sought to obtain the Vial of Dragon Blood, and was the greatest enemy and challenger of Mutare.
hero.campaign-heroes.ordwald.name: Ordwald
hero.campaign-heroes.ordwald.specialty.d: Casts Slayer with effect increased by 4 for level 1 creatures, by 3 for level 2 creatures, by 2 for level 3 creatures, and by 1 for level 4 creatures.
hero.campaign-heroes.youngAlkin.biograph: King Tralossk never really liked Alkin, but gave him his own command in the hopes that he would one day get himself killed. That never happened, and Alkin has led a long and glorious career, much to the displeasure of the King.
hero.campaign-heroes.youngAlkin.name: Alkin
hero.campaign-heroes.youngAlkin.specialt: Increases the Speed of allied Gorgons and Mighty Gorgons by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
hero.campaign-heroes.youngCatherine.biog: As the reigning queen of Erathia, Catherine continues to wage war to secure her homeland's borders and restablish the peace built by her father. However, support for her position is faltering as the country grows weary of war.
hero.campaign-heroes.youngCatherine.name: Catherine
hero.campaign-heroes.youngCatherine.spec: Increases the speed of any Swordsmen or Crusaders by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
hero.campaign-heroes.youngChristian.biog: Christian was always more of a frontiersman than a Knight, having set foot in nearly every part of Enroth before finally settling into military service in Erathia. Though a wanderer and a bit of dreamer, his battefield tactics are feared throughout the world.
hero.campaign-heroes.youngChristian.name: Christian
hero.campaign-heroes.youngChristian.spec: Increases the Ballista's Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
hero.campaign-heroes.youngGem.biography: Gem was one of the greatest sorceresses that Enroth had ever seen, serving King Roland Ironfist during the Succession Wars. Shortly after Roland had secured the throne of Enroth, Gem left for Antagarich.
hero.campaign-heroes.youngGem.name: Gem
Receives a 5% per level bonus to First Aid skill.
hero.campaign-heroes.youngSandro.biograp: Sandro first studied Necromancy under the tutelage of the wizard, and later the lich, Ethric. Sandro has seen nearly all of Enroth and Erathia, and now serves Finneas Vilmar, leader of the Necromancers of Deyja.
hero.campaign-heroes.youngSandro.name: Sandro
hero.campaign-heroes.youngSandro.special: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Sorcery skill percentage.
hero.campaign-heroes.youngYog.biography: Yog studied many years with the Wizards of Bracada, but he would rather spend his time engaging in swordplay rather than studying magic.
hero.campaign-heroes.youngYog.name: Yog
Casts Chain Lightning with damage increased by 3% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
mod.name: Campaign Heroes
mod.description: All 20 campaign heroes are now available in random maps
